items.title: KPIT Q2 FY27 profit falls ~29% to ₹120.66 crore; constant-currency growth just 0.2%
items.text: KPIT reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹16,909.66 million (+6.5% YoY in INR, +0.2% in constant currency) and PAT of ₹1,206.57 million versus ₹1,690.87 million a year earlier. EBITDA margin was 17.8% against 21.1% a year ago, up 60 bps QoQ. Neither source mentions sodium-ion, so the Trentar licence remains an unquantified, long-dated option; weak core auto-services earnings are what is driving the stock.
